DIGIMON_ACHIEVE_C_1.name: Reached Chapter 1
DIGIMON_ACHIEVE_C_1.description: Cyber Sleuth: It's me, Mr. Navit! You enjoying Digimon Capture? Can't wait to see what you guys get up to!

DIGIMON_ACHIEVE_C_2.name: Reached Chapter 2
DIGIMON_ACHIEVE_C_2.description: Cyber Sleuth: Never thought I'd get an assistant like this. And that half-cyber body...heh. Looks like things are about to get interesting.

DIGIMON_ACHIEVE_C_3.name: Reached Chapter 3
DIGIMON_ACHIEVE_C_3.description: Cyber Sleuth: EDEN Syndrome, and that gloomy woman... Your fate as a cyber sleuth has only just begun!

DIGIMON_ACHIEVE_C_4.name: Reached Chapter 4
DIGIMON_ACHIEVE_C_4.description: Cyber Sleuth: Why did Agumon and the other Digimon come to EDEN? Better think on it all night long! Not that there's night in EDEN...

DIGIMON_ACHIEVE_C_5.name: Reached Chapter 5
DIGIMON_ACHIEVE_C_5.description: Cyber Sleuth: Eaters, a "white ghost boy," and now a cyber sleuth? Cool! About time I got in on this party!

DIGIMON_ACHIEVE_C_6.name: Reached Chapter 6
DIGIMON_ACHIEVE_C_6.description: Cyber Sleuth: Kamishiro's pulling the strings behind the hacker revolt? If that's true, I gotta do something as leader of the Zaxons!

DIGIMON_ACHIEVE_C_7.name: Reached Chapter 7
DIGIMON_ACHIEVE_C_7.description: Cyber Sleuth: All things change, and more phenomena are explained every day! Youthful curiosity plays a key role in this, don't you think? Tee-hee...

DIGIMON_ACHIEVE_C_8.name: Reached Chapter 8
DIGIMON_ACHIEVE_C_8.description: Cyber Sleuth: That ugly thing looked like it hasn't given up. Bring it anytime, I'll clean your clock.

DIGIMON_ACHIEVE_C_9.name: Reached Chapter 9
DIGIMON_ACHIEVE_C_9.description: Cyber Sleuth: That conceited Arata's proposing infiltration, but these are two separate things! Time for the Rebels!

DIGIMON_ACHIEVE_C_10.name: Reached Chapter 10
DIGIMON_ACHIEVE_C_10.description: Cyber Sleuth: The first victim of EDEN Syndrome...just who is it? Also...that coffee isn't fit for human consumption...

DIGIMON_ACHIEVE_C_11.name: Reached Chapter 11
DIGIMON_ACHIEVE_C_11.description: Cyber Sleuth: My name is Omegamon. I must convey to you the crisis approaching your world and mine!

DIGIMON_ACHIEVE_C_12.name: Reached Chapter 12
DIGIMON_ACHIEVE_C_12.description: Cyber Sleuth: What the?! Just as I think I've saved Yuuko, how come you're the one who's disappeared now!?

DIGIMON_ACHIEVE_C_13.name: Reached Chapter 13
DIGIMON_ACHIEVE_C_13.description: Cyber Sleuth: That Arata... What's he thinking of doing on his own!? Hurry back, Little Kyoko... They're gonna need your help!

DIGIMON_ACHIEVE_C_14.name: Reached Chapter 14
DIGIMON_ACHIEVE_C_14.description: Cyber Sleuth: You found my lil' partner! Not bad! I'll call you again if something comes up! ...Refuse, and I'll arrest you.

DIGIMON_ACHIEVE_C_15.name: Reached Chapter 15
DIGIMON_ACHIEVE_C_15.description: Cyber Sleuth: I know you must be worried about Arata Sanada's whereabouts, but there's something you gotta do now. ...Time for a counterattack.

DIGIMON_ACHIEVE_C_16.name: Reached Chapter 16
DIGIMON_ACHIEVE_C_16.description: Cyber Sleuth: Me 'n' Veevee are happy to have more allies! ...But wait, what happened to the kid!? That right arm doesn't look good, ya know!?

DIGIMON_ACHIEVE_C_17.name: Reached Chapter 17
DIGIMON_ACHIEVE_C_17.description: Cyber Sleuth: People can't help but laugh at the unsightliness that accompanies change, yes? It's a much better look than succumbing to sadness, though.

DIGIMON_ACHIEVE_C_18.name: Reached Chapter 18
DIGIMON_ACHIEVE_C_18.description: Cyber Sleuth: Before I knew it I was back in Akihabara...but why just me? Does this mean... Did I get revenge for my father?

DIGIMON_ACHIEVE_C_19.name: Reached Chapter 19
DIGIMON_ACHIEVE_C_19.description: Cyber Sleuth: The five of us are childhood friends? Kyoko is a Digimon!? Wasabi, hatcho miso and cream cheese!? Argh, my head!!!

DIGIMON_ACHIEVE_C_20.name: Reached Chapter 20
DIGIMON_ACHIEVE_C_20.description: Cyber Sleuth: Fools. Every last one of you is a total fool. ...Even so, you're my friends. Let's go, our fifth friend is waiting for us.
